closes #1694 
# Introduces a configurable MIGRATION_MODE (async | sync | skip) to control how migrations run at startup.
• Runs migrations in the background by default so the app starts serving requests immediately.
• Adds advisory/file locks with timeouts to prevent migrations from blocking forever.
• Tracks migration state (pending → running → succeeded/failed) in a shared status object.
• Exposes migration progress in the health endpoint for visibility.
• Supports batched data updates to avoid long-running, table-locking migrations.
• Preserves legacy blocking behavior via sync mode when needed.
